name: Radiohead

whyMatters.en: Abingdon five-piece formed in 1985. Moved from UK alternative guitar records to OK Computer (1997) multi-section songs and Kid A (2000) electronics, with the same lineup throughout.
whyMatters.zh: 阿宾登五人组，1985 年成立。从英国 alternative 吉他唱片走到 OK Computer（1997）的多段体与 Kid A（2000）的电子制作，阵容全程未换人。

note.en: Multi-section song; prog length and dynamic cuts on alternative radio.
note.zh: 多段体歌曲；prog 时长与动态切换出现在 alternative 电台。

note.en: Piano-led single from the OK Computer cycle.
note.zh: OK Computer 周期的钢琴主导单曲。

note.en: Kid A opener: sequenced keys and processed vocal before guitar-led arrangements.
note.zh: Kid A 开场：音序键盘与处理人声先于吉他主导编曲。

interviewQuotes.text: Anyone who uses the word 'career' and 'music' in the same sentence should be shot.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Thom Yorke

interviewQuotes.text: We want to make music that surprises us.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jonny Greenwood

lyricQuotes: I'm not here, this isn't happening
For a minute there, I lost myself

shortBio.en: Yorke / Greenwood five-piece; Paranoid Android and Kid A mark structure then electronics.
shortBio.zh: Yorke / Greenwood 五人组；Paranoid Android 与 Kid A 分别标记多段结构与电子制作。

body.en:
Formed in 1985 as On a Friday. Pablo Honey and The Bends established guitar-band writing; OK Computer expanded multi-section songs and studio detail; Kid A and Amnesiac foreground electronics and jazz-influenced rhythm sections.

Paranoid Android (1997) places prog-length form on alternative radio. Everything in Its Right Place (2000) opens Kid A with sequenced keys rather than lead guitar.
body.zh:
1985 年组建，曾用名 On a Friday。Pablo Honey 与 The Bends 确立吉他乐队写法；OK Computer 扩展多段体与录音室细节；Kid A 与 Amnesiac 突出电子与带爵士色彩的节奏组。

Paranoid Android（1997）把 prog 时长放进 alternative 电台。Everything in Its Right Place（2000）以音序键盘而非主音吉他打开 Kid A。

title.en: From guitar hits to studio change
title.zh: 从吉他热单到录音室转向

body.en:
Radiohead built hit capability on The Bends, then changed recording methods on later albums. The five members stayed the same; instruments and production did not.

After 1997, the band continued festival and arena dates while releasing records that used electronics, jazz players, and long-form song structures.
body.zh:
Radiohead 在 The Bends 上具备热单能力，随后在后期专辑更换录音方法。五人成员未变；乐器与制作方式有变。

1997 年后，乐队继续音乐节与体育场档期，同时发行使用电子、爵士乐手与长结构的唱片。

body.en:
Lineup churn is rare: Yorke, Jonny Greenwood, O’Brien, Colin Greenwood, and Selway remain the catalog band.

Side projects (Yorke solo, Atoms for Peace) run beside Radiohead rather than replacing members. Album eras differ by approach, not by singer swaps.
body.zh:
阵容更替很少：Yorke、Jonny Greenwood、O’Brien、Colin Greenwood、Selway 是目录固定成员。

旁支项目（Yorke 独唱、Atoms for Peace）与 Radiohead 并行，不替换成员。专辑分期按方法区分，不按换主唱区分。

body.en:
A multi-section song on alternative radio: dynamic cuts, guitar orchestration, and length beyond standard verse-chorus singles.

Form and runtime are the main identifiers on the OK Computer cycle.
body.zh:
alternative 电台上的多段体：动态切割、吉他配器，以及超出常规主副歌单曲的时长。

曲式与片长是 OK Computer 周期的主要识别点。

body.en:
Sequenced parts and processed piano open the album; guitars sit further back. Jazz players and electronics appear in the session credits.

Commercial risk is documented in the press; the musical change is fewer guitar-led singles inside a well-known rock catalog.
body.zh:
音序声部与处理后的钢琴打开专辑；吉他位置后移。爵士乐手与电子出现在录音名单。

商业风险有当时媒体记录；音乐变化是在知名摇滚目录里减少吉他主导单曲。

title.en: Prog form and UK indie charts
title.zh: Prog 曲式与英国 indie 榜

body.en:
Odd song forms and dense textures sit beside UK indie distribution and US alternative chart runs. Later 2000s art-rock and electronic-adjacent guitar bands cite the catalog.

The band kept both underground press coverage and arena tour dates.
body.zh:
奇数曲式与密集纹理，旁靠英国 indie 发行体系与美国 alternative 榜表现。2000 年代后期 art-rock 与电子邻近的吉他乐队常引用该目录。

乐队同时保有地下媒体关注与体育场巡演档期。

title.zh: 关于「生涯」话术的媒体摘句

body.en:
Yorke’s press excerpts reject rock-star career framing. They sit beside careful touring and catalog control.

Useful as attributed posture; check against the release and tour schedule.
body.zh:
Yorke 的媒体摘句拒绝摇滚明星式生涯表述。旁靠细致的巡演安排与目录控制。

可作有出处的姿态材料，对照发行与巡演日程核验。

note.en: Stable lineup; side projects run beside the band.
note.zh: 阵容稳定；旁支项目与乐队并行。

note.en: Alt-radio multi-section hit before the Kid A electronics shift.
note.zh: Kid A 电子转向之前的 alternative 电台多段体热单。

note.en: After OK Computer, later albums keep changing studio method inside a mass rock catalog.
note.zh: OK Computer 之后，后期专辑在大众摇滚目录内继续更换录音室方法。
